name: SpecialCase XLIFF Bridge for ACF and Polylang
author: Special Case

sections.description:
SpecialCase XLIFF Bridge for ACF and Polylang is a professional tool designed to streamline the translation workflow for WordPress sites using ACF and Polylang. It bridges the gap between custom field content and CAT (Computer-Assisted Translation) tools.

The plugin allows you to export text from all native and custom fields created via ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) from any page or post into the industry-standard XLIFF format. Once translated, the file can be imported back directly into the linked Polylang translation.

Main Features

  • Complete Export: Extracts content from all ACF fields into a single XLIFF file.
  • Seamless Workflow: Export from the source language and import directly into the target language translation.
  • Professional Translation Ready: Compatible with major CAT tools like Trados, Smartcat, or Phrase.
  • Automatic Sync: Automatically populates the linked post’s fields upon import.

About the Author

Developed by Special Case Team.
Visit our website for more information: https://specialcase.net/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the acf-polylang-xliff-bridge folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure both Advanced Custom Fields (Pro) and Polylang (Pro) are active.
sections.faq:
Which PHP versions are supported?

The plugin requires PHP 7.4.33 or higher to function correctly.

Does it work with ACF Free?

The plugin is tested and optimized for the PRO versions of ACF and Polylang.

Must the field structure be identical?

Yes. For the synchronization to work, the linked translation (target post) must contain an identical ACF field structure.
